# BAD-007 — Fix two gaps in BadTakes docs/RELEASING.md sections 5 and 7

## Brief
Section 5 downloads into /tmp/bt-win without clearing it, and section 6 then runs cp /tmp/bt-win/*/* dist/release/, so a previous release's Windows files still sitting there get staged beside the new ones. Section 7's gh release create shows a generic --notes string and no --title, which contradicts the cutting-a-release skill (every release ships notes from docs/release-notes/<v>/body.md) and Eric's bare-title rule (title vX.Y.Z).

Evidence: During BAD-005 phase 4 on 2026-09-14, /tmp/bt-win still held Bad-Takes-0.13.3-x64-setup.exe, Bad-Takes-0.13.3-x64-win.zip and latest.yml from Sep 10; they were moved aside by hand before the 0.13.4 download. RELEASING.md lines 375-378 (no rm) and 446-448 (--notes 'Bad Takes v<X.Y.Z> ... See badtakes.io for what's new.', no --title). Fix: rm -rf /tmp/bt-win before gh run download in section 5; in section 7 use --title "v<X.Y.Z>" --notes-file docs/release-notes/<X.Y.Z>/body.md.

## Size, persona and model decision
One writer on sonnet: a two-section docs edit in one file, no code. Section 6's dist/release staging checked for the same stale-file defect.
